b:if.title: | KriTere

div.p: KriTere.com, named after two sisters, KrisAnn and Terez, offers two family-friendly, intelligent, educational and fun board games: Don't Get Mad! and Kris Ann's Journey. Easily play on any device: PC, web browser or Android app.
Roll the die and race to the Festival of Lights. Anyone can win!
Travel the world, answer quiz questions and plan smart moves.
Game night with family or friends, on one phone.

button.aria-label: Play the Don't Get Mad! trailer

img.alt: Don't Get Mad! trailer: colorful board with pawns and a crown

div.p: A dice board game where nobody is safe: the leader can lose it all near the finish, and the player in last place can still win.
Roll the die and race from your front door to the Festival of Lights. Every square is the next moment of the same trip, the kind every grown-up knows.
Every square is a little story. Collect all 16 postcards!
A train that is actually on time
Sheep with right of way
A hotel booking that never existed
Fly ahead in a hot-air balloon
Get stuck in the mud
Swap places with the leader
Forget your keys. Then forget them again.
The Festival of Lights: you made it!

div.blockquote: Luck makes everyone equal. A child can beat a grown-up, and your little brother can beat you.

img.alt: Don't Get Mad!: Game night just got more fun
Don't Get Mad!: Their lucky break? Cancel it.
Don't Get Mad!: Every throw can change everything.
Don't Get Mad!: Bragging rights. Until the next game.

ul.li: 🎲 2 to 4 players on one phone, or vs the computer
🗺️ Two journeys: a quick trip or the grand journey
🃏 Bonus cards and lanterns that turn the game around
🎨 A hand-drawn, animated picture for every moment

div.p: No ads. No in-app purchases. No accounts. No data collected. Just the game.
A strategy board game and trivia quiz in one!

button.aria-label: Play the Kris Ann's Journey trailer

img.alt: Kris Ann's Journey trailer: the globe under a starry sky

div.p: Travel the world, answer quiz questions and make smart choices to score the most points.
Play with family and friends on one phone or tablet, or against robots.
Each traveller plays differently, so every game feels new.
Never pays for tickets and answers the airline quiz instead.
Flies and sails fast.
Travels fast and can go to any airport or port.
Earns a point on every trip and a bonus for 3 continents.
Walk to the next area, fly, sail, take the train, ride the bus or rent a car. Earn points for every new place and every new continent. Reach a wonder first and buy its tours.
No dice: you choose every move. Pay visas and tour fees, own citizenships and businesses, and collect when other players visit.
One turn, one action, one decision. Luck adds spice, but good play wins.
Hundreds of fun facts about countries, wonders, food, animals, languages and inventions.
✈️ Airline quiz: answer right and fly for free.
🛂 Citizenship exam: read facts about a place, answer the questions and become a citizen.
What money does the Seychelles use?

div.span: Right +1, wrong -1. The journey goes on either way.

img.alt: Kris Ann's Journey: the colorful world map
Kris Ann's Journey: the Backpacker travels in China East
Kris Ann's Journey: which flag? challenge in New Zealand
Kris Ann's Journey: which currency? challenge

ul.li: 👪2 to 4 players on one device, people or robots
🤖Robots at easy, normal or hard level
⏳30 turns (53 areas, 7 wonders) or 50 turns (84 areas, 11 wonders)
💾Your game is saved, so you can continue later

div.p: No ads. No in-app purchases. No accounts. Works fully offline. No chat and no personal data collected.
Both are perfect for game night with family and friends. Here is how to choose.

ul.li: You want quick laughs and big surprises
Little ones are playing: luck makes everyone equal
You have a short break or a long evening
You love planning your moves: no dice
You enjoy trivia and fun facts
You want to explore the world together
You like learning while you play

img.alt: A family laughing together while playing Kris Ann's Journey on a tablet

div.p: Peace of mind for grown-ups, pure fun for kids. Both games are made to be handed over without worry.

div.p: 👪 For all ages: 2 to 4 players around one device, or challenge the AI robots.

figure.figcaption: Our very first board, drawn by hand ✏️

div.p: KriTere.com is named after two sisters, KrisAnn & Terez.

🎲 Don't Get Mad! started on paper: father and daughter drew this colorful board game by hand, complete with every square and story. They had so much fun playing it together that they decided to share it with everyone in electronic form.
🗺️ Then came Kris Ann's Journey, a strategy board game and trivia quiz in one. Both games are ideal for a fun game night with family and friends!
